purpose: Conditional production-only NLL adaptation of TL3's existing plain student member, replacing one weight file while preserving the fixed three-member serving graph.

admission.condition: Wait for independent grades of the active F0 pair and any admitted F1 pair. Admit one final production student fit only if the evidence and controller decision support NLL adaptation.
admission.training_membership: All supplied train and valid groups are intended for final fitting; final local scores are exposed and ancestry-contaminated because the TL3 initializer ancestry is unknown.

source_package.inspection: Archive hash verified; members.json, solution.py, ZIP entry sizes and recorded tensor-shape metadata inspected. No NPZ array values were loaded and Torch was not imported.

original_members.name: distilled_s5@ep1
original_members.member_sha256_note: No separate member SHA was found in the import receipt; preserve the original ZIP hash as the immutable source binding.

ancestry.package_description: Champion H256 student plus all-data tied-encoder parents.
ancestry.required_label: official team asset; TL3 fit/teacher/initializer membership unknown, possibly all-data; never assert clean fold or independent fit

available_checkpoint.source: Root metadata review found no matching TL3 Torch checkpoint under artifacts/runs; preserve this NPZ member as the only known initializer payload.

source_shapes.gru: two layers, H256, standard GRU weight_ih/weight_hh/bias_ih/bias_hh tensors for layers 0 and 1

member_compatibility.metadata_assessment: Key names and shapes match the canonical RNNModel state, including mean/std buffers; strict loading is structurally plausible, not yet executed.

export_frontend.reuse_status: Its generic infer_architecture/load_fp32_model path covers this plain 211-input GRU shape, but current SUPPORTED_CANDIDATES/member_source allowlist does not contain TL3. Add an explicit pinned TL3 source record in a future reviewed converter; do not bypass provenance checks silently.

serving_contract.replacement: Replace weights_s5.npz only, preserving coefficient 0.34 and the two tied models at 0.33 each.
serving_contract.native_frontend: Keep the original wnn_cpp wrapper and libraries; do not switch to the Rust native frontend because it rejects the 263-input tied members.
serving_contract.original_inference: The wrapper invokes wnn_cpp.Ensemble with fast_activations=True, quant_backend=auto, and dynamic_int8 enabled for members without an fp32 marker.
serving_contract.serving_export: Slice head.2.weight and head.2.bias to rows 0:2 (the means); omit the two logvariance rows. Keep the NPZ state-key contract accepted by the original C++ loader.
serving_contract.runtime_claim: Member count and architecture are preserved by design; package size, ABI compatibility, native prediction delta, and runtime must be measured on the new archive before any release claim.

conversion_gates.name: source_binding
conversion_gates.required: Recheck the original ZIP SHA and record the weights_s5 member identity; never modify or overwrite the original ZIP.

conversion_gates.name: shape_dtype_strict_load
conversion_gates.required: Read NPZ with allow_pickle=False in future converter; confirm all 16 names, FP32 dtypes and shapes; instantiate the exact RNNModel configuration and use strict state loading, including exact mean/std buffers.

conversion_gates.name: checkpoint_roundtrip
conversion_gates.required: Compare every initial FP32 state tensor bitwise before and after checkpoint save/reload; compare direct-NPZ-loaded and reloaded-checkpoint PyTorch outputs on a small fixed causal input fixture.

conversion_gates.name: native_bridge_diagnostic
conversion_gates.required: Compare original dynamic-int8 wnn_cpp member output against canonical FP32 PyTorch output on the same source-pinned causal fixtures, reporting max/quantile deltas and official-metric diagnostic. Treat this as a measured precision/runtime difference, not bitwise conversion parity; predeclare an acceptable bound before promotion.

conversion_gates.name: ancestry_policy
conversion_gates.required: Create provenance that names the official ZIP/member hash and explicitly records unknown training/teacher/initializer membership. Do not fabricate fit groups or populate fields solely to pass the current final-model-adaptation validator.

conditional_final_adaptation.starter: Converted TL3 weights_s5 plain two-output state, after the conversion gates pass.

training_schedule_to_carry_forward_if_su.precision: strict FP32; autocast and TF32 off
training_schedule_to_carry_forward_if_su.seed_status: Prospective placeholder, distinct from screen seeds 3/4 and subject to final recipe freeze after grades.

target_cache.policy: Reuse recorded float32 main_history targets at scale 1.0; do not renormalize coefficient sum. The NLL objective then uses 0.9 clipped cache + 0.1 clipped labels. No family cache is needed.
target_cache.trainer_blocker: Pinned NLL CLI accepts source/normalized/homogeneous variants, rejects history, and requires a clean split manifest for distillation caches. A reviewed explicit production-only all-data cache validator is required.

propensity.candidate_basis: The existing all-data history-swap student's provenance records this propensity with power 2, eps 0.03 and valid_true_mask 0.03.
propensity.status: Unverified for the converted TL3 starter; verify complete all-data row coverage and provenance before freezing. Do not imply TL3 used this propensity.

requirements: Support complete supplied train+valid membership without pretending a clean held-out fold exists.
Accept the original official-team NPZ-derived initializer with ancestry explicitly unknown; do not forge a clean fit manifest or all-data-membership claim for TL3.
Validate the history cache metadata, source ancestry, complete row order and hashes while keeping clean-fold cache validation unchanged.
Record no evaluation or checkpoint selection on rows used for production fitting.

conditional_final_adaptation.postfit_serving_export: Build a new two-output NPZ from the trained four-output checkpoint by slicing only the final linear readout rows 0:2; keep all other FP32 tensors and inherited mean/std exactly, then test loading through the original wnn_cpp package path.
conditional_final_adaptation.final_comparison: Compare the fixed three-member adapted package with the unchanged TL3 package on source-qualified panels as exposed diagnostics only. Unknown TL3 ancestry and all-data production fitting prevent clean-fold claims; report public transfer separately when available.
conditional_final_adaptation.reason_no_exact_argv: Current trainer does not accept the full-data history cache or an NPZ-derived initializer with unknown fit membership under its clean-fold final-adaptation gate.

resource_and_evidence.budget: A single production fit plus conversion/export/package checks; no teacher fit or fourth served model. Measure actual runtime and memory at admission; no estimate is claimed.
resource_and_evidence.existing_tl3_exposure: The original TL3 local F0 diagnostic was 0.701818 on an exposed panel; it is not a clean estimate and does not establish expected public score.
resource_and_evidence.screen_gate: Use the F0/F1 results to decide whether NLL and its fixed schedule warrant the final production adaptation. Do not rank the final all-data fit as an independent fold run.
resource_and_evidence.changed_artifacts: None in this preparation; original archive, wrapper, C++ libraries, checkpoints, cache, grader and source remain unmodified.
